concepts.name: CardName
concepts.definition: The English name of a Magic card.

concepts.name: Artist
concepts.definition: The illustrator credited on a card.

concepts.name: BorderColor
concepts.definition: The border color style of a card (e.g. black, white, borderless).

concepts.name: Power
concepts.definition: The power value printed on a creature card; '*' or NULL means unknown/infinite.

concepts.name: IsPromo
concepts.definition: Flag indicating the card is a promotional printing.

concepts.name: IsStorySpotlight
concepts.definition: Flag indicating the card is part of the Story Spotlight series.

concepts.name: IsTextless
concepts.definition: Flag indicating the card has no text box.
aliases: do not have a text box

concepts.name: CardKingdomFoilId
concepts.definition: Card Kingdom foil product identifier; non-null means a foil version exists.

concepts.name: CardKingdomId
concepts.definition: Card Kingdom product identifier; non-null means a Card Kingdom listing exists.

concepts.name: FrameVersion
concepts.definition: The frame style/version of the card (e.g. 1993, 1997, 2003, 2015, future).

concepts.name: Colors
concepts.definition: The color(s) of the card (e.g. 'B' for black).

concepts.name: CardText
concepts.definition: The rules text of the card.

concepts.name: SetName
concepts.definition: The English name of a card set.

concepts.name: BaseSetSize
concepts.definition: The number of cards in the base set.

concepts.name: IsForeignOnly
concepts.definition: Flag indicating the set is only available outside the United States.
aliases: only available outside the United States

concepts.name: SetTranslation
concepts.definition: The localized translation of a set name.

concepts.name: Language
concepts.definition: The language of a card printing or set translation.

concepts.name: ForeignName
concepts.definition: The localized name of a card in a foreign language.

concepts.name: ForeignType
concepts.definition: The localized type line of a card in a foreign language.

concepts.name: Format
concepts.definition: The name of a play format (e.g. commander, standard).

concepts.name: LegalityStatus
concepts.definition: The legality status of a card in a format (Legal, Banned, Restricted, etc.).

concepts.name: RulingCount
concepts.definition: The number of rulings associated with a card.

caveats.statement: Power can be '*' or NULL for unknown/infinite power cards, so equality checks miss NULLs.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE power = '*' OR power IS NULL;

caveats.statement: Some cards have no foreign_data rows, so language-based joins drop them.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards c LEFT JOIN foreign_data f ON c.uuid = f.uuid WHERE f.uuid IS NULL;

caveats.statement: Some cards have no legalities rows, so format filters exclude them.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards c LEFT JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid WHERE l.uuid IS NULL;

caveats.statement: Some cards have no rulings, so ruling-count aggregations must handle zero.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards c LEFT JOIN rulings r ON c.uuid = r.uuid WHERE r.uuid IS NULL;

caveats.statement: cardKingdomFoilId and cardKingdomId may be NULL independently, so 'powerful foil' requires both non-null.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND cardKingdomId IS NULL;

caveats.statement: Set translations may be missing for some languages, so translation lookups can return NULL.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM set_translations WHERE translation IS NULL;

caveats.statement: Legality status values are case-sensitive strings like 'Legal' and 'Banned'.

themes.name: CardLanguage

themes.name: CardFrameVersion

themes.name: CardBorderColor
themes.definition: Which border color style a card uses.

themes.name: CardColor

themes.name: SetType

derived.name: PercentageChineseSimplified
derived.definition: Share of cards that have a Chinese Simplified printing.
aliases: percentage of the cards available in Chinese Simplified

derived.name: PercentageBorderless
derived.definition: Share of cards with borderless border color.

derived.name: PercentageStorySpotlightTextless
derived.definition: Share of Story Spotlight cards that are textless.
aliases: percentage of Story Spotlight cards that do not have a text
derived.formula: COUNT(CardName WHERE IsStorySpotlight = 1 AND IsTextless = 1) / COUNT(CardName WHERE IsStorySpotlight = 1) * 100

derived.name: PercentagePowerfulFoilsInSet
derived.definition: Share of cards in a set that have both Card Kingdom foil and non-foil IDs.
aliases: percentage of incredibly powerful cards in the set
derived.formula: COUNT(CardName WHERE SetName = 'Coldsnap' AND CardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND CardKingdomId IS NOT NULL) / COUNT(CardName WHERE SetName = 'Coldsnap') * 100

derived.name: CountUnknownPower
derived.definition: Number of cards whose power is '*' or NULL.
aliases: how many cards have infinite power
derived.formula: COUNT(CardName WHERE Power = '*' OR Power IS NULL)

derived.name: CountUnknownPowerWithTriggeredAbility
derived.definition: Number of unknown-power cards whose text mentions a triggered ability.
aliases: unknown power cards contain info about the triggered ability
derived.formula: COUNT(CardName WHERE (Power = '*' OR Power IS NULL) AND CardText LIKE '%triggered ability%')

derived.name: CountItalianSetsUnder100
derived.definition: Number of sets with an Italian translation and base set size under 100.
aliases: sets of cards that have an Italian translation with base set

derived.name: MaxRulingCount
derived.definition: Maximum number of rulings associated with any single card.

derived.name: CountLegalCommanderUnknownPower
derived.definition: Number of unknown-power cards legal in commander format.
aliases: cards with unknown power legal for commander
derived.formula: COUNT(CardName WHERE (Power = '*' OR Power IS NULL) AND Format = 'commander' AND LegalityStatus = 'Legal')

derived.name: CountBannedByArtist
derived.definition: Number of banned cards illustrated by a given artist.
aliases: banned cards Allen Williams worked on
derived.formula: COUNT(CardName WHERE Artist = 'Allen Williams' AND LegalityStatus = 'Banned')

derived.name: CountForeignLanguageArtifactsBlack
derived.definition: Number of black Artifact cards that have a foreign-language printing.
aliases: Artifact cards which are black color and come with foreign l
derived.formula: COUNT(CardName WHERE ForeignType LIKE '%Artifact%' AND Colors = 'B' AND Language IS NOT NULL)

derived.name: CountBorderlessWithoutPowerfulFoils
derived.definition: Number of borderless cards that lack a Card Kingdom foil listing.
aliases: borderless cards available without powerful foils
derived.formula: COUNT(CardName WHERE BorderColor = 'borderless' AND (CardKingdomFoilId IS NULL OR CardKingdomId IS NULL))
